description: Compute the current sky × one agent's natal chart: which transiting planets are activating which natal points, with aspect type/orb/exactness, dominant boost element, and continuous boost magnitude (0..1). Replaces the global 'Transit Active' badge with per-agent overlays. Optional `_meta.apiKey` (your alchm.kitchen API key) and `_meta.caller` (your client identifier, e.g. 'claude-desktop') unlock per-user quotas and invocation telemetry.

focusPlanets.description: Transiting planets to include (default: Sun, Moon, Mars, Saturn, Jupiter, Pluto)

latitude.description: Latitude for the transit chart (default: 40.7498 NYC)

longitude.description: Longitude for the transit chart (default: -73.7976 NYC)

transitTime.description: ISO 8601 timestamp for the transit moment (default: now)

name: get_transit_natal_overlay
